source: Tier B, MODELLED - this boat's own table, anchored on a SISTER HULL's ORC certificate, not on a certificate of this boat. It is that hull's white-sail polar in its 41.66 m2 jib configuration, read onto the app grid; this boat's own jib area, loading and keel are unknown, and the sign of the resulting error is unknown. Against the builder's ORC VPP 1.11 jib polar for another Salona 44 sister hull (2010, CRO 2009) the table differs by -5% to +9% per cell; that compares two sister-hull VPP runs and is not an error bound for this boat. Below about 8 kn the table decides between sailing and motoring, so a leg may be motored that would sail, or the reverse. Flat-water racing VPP - tune with the performance factor. NOT race-calibrated, and never measured against this boat.
